summary: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation.
takeaways: Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation.
Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains.
However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment.
